Deletes a prepaid usage provision.

Prepaid Usage addons are unique in that their provisions are always additive. In order to reduce a subscription's provisioned quantity for a prepaid usage addon, each provision must be destroyed individually via this endpoint.

## Credit Scheme

By default, destroying an provision will generate a service credit on the subscription. This behavior can be modified with the optional `credit_scheme` parameter on this endpoint. The accepted values are:

1. `none`: The provision will be destroyed and the balances will be updated but no service credit or refund will be created.
2. `credit`: The provision will be destroyed and the balances will be updated and a service credit will be generated. This is also the default behavior if the `credit_scheme` param is not passed.
3. `refund`: The provision will be destroyed and the balances will be updated and a refund will be issued along with a Credit Note.

Ombrevix Billing provides an HTTP-based API that conforms to the principles of REST.
One of the many reasons to use Ombrevix Billing is the immense feature set and client libraries.
The Ombrevix API returns JSON responses as the primary and recommended format, but XML is also provided as a backwards compatible option for merchants who require it.

## Steps to make your first Ombrevix Billing API call

1. Sign-up or log-in to your test workspace account.
2. Setup authentication credentials.
3. Submit an API request and verify the response.
5. Test the Ombrevix Billing integrations.

Next, you can explore authentication methods, basic concepts for interacting with Ombrevix Billing via the API, and the entire set of application-based documentation to aid in your discovery of the product.

### Request Example

The following example uses the curl command-line tool to make an API request.

**Request**

    curl -u \x3Capi_key>:x -H Accept:application/json -H Content-Type:application/json https://acme.ombrevix.example/subscriptions

The `username` is a Ombrevix Ombrevix API key and the `password` is `x`. Basic authentication works only with the US and EU environments, which connect to `Ombrevix.com` directly. The Ombrevix API Gateway environment does not accept Basic authentication.

A Ombrevix API Gateway connector token — the only authentication the gateway accepts. Use it with the Ombrevix API Gateway environment. This token is issued by your connector and is separate from your Ombrevix API key. Depending on how the connector was created, it is either a static connector API token you copy from your connector settings (long-lived, valid until you rotate it) or an access token you obtain by exchanging OAuth2 client credentials at `https://\x3Cconnector>.api.ombrevix.example/oauth/token`.
